text: Seabrook Town ने Harbour City को 4-2 से मात दी, जहाँ Harbour City ने Elias Okafor और Marek Barros के गोल कर 2-0 की बढ़त बनाई [#905] [#975]। लेकिन Joon Whitfield को 43वें मिनट में रेड कार्ड मिलने के बाद Harbour City की टीम कमजोर पड़ गई [#871]। Seabrook Town ने 65वें मिनट में अपनी रणनीति बदली, उन्होंने ज्यादा दवाब और तेज़ खेल अपनाया, जिससे उनका कब्जा बढ़ा और उन्होंने 4 गोल से मैच पलट दिया [#1361] [#1882]। खासकर Kian Romano ने 90+2 और 90+3 मिनट में तेजी से गोल कर मैच में धमाल मचा दिया, जो 30 और 43 सेकंड बाद की गोलिंग की दो मिसालें हैं, उन्होंने टीम को जीत दिलाई [#1882] [#1906]। Marek Barros, हालांकि हारने वाली टीम से थे, उन्हें मैच का बेहतरीन खिलाड़ी चुना गया, क्योंकि उन्होंने 1 गोल, 2 असिस्ट, और 9 इंटरसेप्शन किए, 14.74 किमी दौड़कर कड़ी मेहनत दिखाई । Seabrook Town ने अपनी तेज और चौड़ी गेम प्लानिंग से अधिक शॉट्स (22), बॉक्स में ज्यादा स्पर्श (57), और ज़्यादा कोनों (9) लिए, जो उनकी आक्रामकता दिखाते हैं ।

- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals compared to Harbour City's 2, winning 4-2 [#905 #975 #1104 #1448 #1882 #1906].
- Marek Barros of Harbour City was named player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a rating of 9.8 [Player of the match section].
- Seabrook Town dominated shots with 22 compared to Harbour City's 10, and had a higher xG of 3.48 vs 1.0 [team_stats].
- Joon Whitfield (Harbour City) received a red card at 43', impacting Harbour City's defensive capabilities [#871 #870].
- Seabrook Town made a tactical change at 65', increasing press and directness, which preceded their comeback from 0-2 to win 4-2 [#1361 #1104 #1448 #1882 #1906].

- Seabrook Town’s comeback and late goals were facilitated by quick regains and counter-attacks, especially seen in Kian Romano’s 90+2’ goal which came after a regain and a quick two-pass build-up lasting 6.7 seconds, demonstrating effective transitional play from defence to attack [1881, 1882].
- Harbour City, playing a 4-2-3-1 with a patient short passing style, built their first goal through a prolonged, intricate 17-pass sequence over 56.7 seconds in open play, showing their controlled build-up approach and positional discipline to create scoring opportunities [904, 905].
- Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 formation with emphasis on wide crossing played a key role in applying pressure and creating chances, evidenced by their higher possession (53.4%), more shots (22 vs. 10), more box touches (57 vs. 42), and more corners (9 vs. 6), reflecting an aggressive wide attacking style throughout the match [team_stats].
- After going behind 2-0, Seabrook Town changed tactically at 65’ to press higher, play more direct, and raise defensive line height, which, although initially decreasing xG and other metrics, eventually helped them regain control and exploit attacking transitions to score three late goals to overturn the deficit [1361].
